data.name: Tomography VR
data.detailed_description:
Curated library

The project brings together 36 tomography scans from scientific collections and archives. The datasets are carefully prepared and presented in VR for direct exploration, without the need for complex specialist tools. Sources include Human Organ Atlas, Battery Imaging Library, Astromaterials 3D, Brain Image Library, and 3D Cipher.

Detailed scans

The internal structure of each object was captured as billions of voxels using advanced imaging equipment, including synchrotrons. Larger scans contain 96 times the detail of a routine hospital CT scan. Your computer needs 32 GB of memory to view them in full.

Easy exploration

The space around you stays clear and you can peel away tissues and materials simply by walking through them, as shown in the trailer. You can also move, rotate, and resize the object while holding the trigger buttons.

X-ray vision simulator

With every frame the app sends millions of rays through the volume and accumulates their signals in real time. Push the thumbsticks up or down to adjust transparency and reveal deeper structures inside the object.

Adaptive resolution

The app maintains stable performance as scene complexity changes. It can run smoothly even at high refresh rates (including 144 Hz) on capable hardware. Not sure how your PC will do? Try the free demo.

Minimal image processing

What you see is the raw scan data: 16-bit grayscale voxels with minor brightness adjustments and the background removed. JPEG 2000 encoder reduces storage requirements and keeps any potential artifacts imperceptible.

Controls

  • Hold trigger buttons: move, rotate, and scale the object

  • Thumbsticks up/down: change object transparency

  • Trackpads: scale the object (Valve Index controllers only)

  • Hold B / Y: clear more space around you when inside the object

  • Hold A / X: show the scan library

  • Grip / squeeze input: unused

Quick actions

  • 1:1 Real size

  • ⟳ Reset view

  • ⧉ Copy link

  • ⏻ Exit app

data.short_description: Step into massive 3D images made up of billions of voxels and explore the internal structures of real objects, from animals and human organs to complex materials and devices.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700 or equivalent
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 90 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR application. Tested runtimes: SteamVR, Meta Horizon Link, and Virtual Desktop. Tested headsets: Valve Index and Meta Quest 3.
  • Additional Notes: The app can run on systems with 16 GB of RAM, but larger scans may load only partially.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700 or better
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 90 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR application. Tested runtimes: SteamVR, Meta Horizon Link, and Virtual Desktop. Tested headsets: Valve Index and Meta Quest 3.
  • Additional Notes: Please run the free demo to confirm that your PCVR setup is compatible.

content_descriptors.notes:
Contains medical CT scans of a male torso and a female torso. 
Contains detailed scans of two reproductive organs: testis and uterus. 
Contains scans of organs from deceased donors. 
May be uncomfortable for people with kenophobia (fear of empty spaces or large voids).
Descriptions and preview images for all included scans are available on the app’s website and in the demo.
